title: SkillGuard action-policy v1

schema_version.description: Policy format version; must be 1, independently of the engine version or policy revision.

id.description: Operator policy identifier, returned as policy_id. Runtime requires 1-128 ASCII characters: first alphanumeric, then alphanumeric or underscore, dot, colon, hyphen.

version.description: Operator policy revision string, returned as policy_version. Uses the same identifier format as id; no automatic version ordering.

max_age_seconds.description: Required assessment lifetime cap, 1-300 seconds. Review/evidence expiry may shorten it; partial/error responses expire immediately. Zero is invalid.

isolated_profiles.description: Operator-attested isolation profile IDs matching request.context_profile. Empty means no verified context. Entries attest existing harness controls; they do not create a sandbox.

subject_fingerprint.description: Exact reviewed action fingerprint from an assessment response; sha256: plus 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

context_fingerprint.description: Exact reviewed context fingerprint from the assessment, including environment, profile and input contents. Same SHA-256 format as subject_fingerprint.

review_id.description: Operator audit reference using the assessment identifier format; not an approval token by itself.

expires_at.description: Nonzero RFC 3339 review expiry; write UTC with Z. Expired records grant no review.

accept_mutable_artifacts.description: Optional, default false. Accepts unresolved artifact bytes only for this exact review; does not waive other checks or prove safety.

reviewed_actions.description: Exact subject/context reviews supplied by an independent operator. Empty grants no reviews. Expiry and all other mandatory checks still apply.

name.description: Exact package name, 1-214 characters at runtime; not a glob. PyPI matching lowercases and normalizes runs of dot, underscore and hyphen.

version.description: Optional; omitted or empty matches all versions. npm requires canonical numeric major.minor.patch; PyPI supports 1-4 numeric components with zero-padding normalization. No ranges or prereleases.

prohibited_packages.description: Optional exact package prohibitions; an omitted list adds none. Matching rules deny and cannot be overridden by review.

prohibited_artifact_hashes.description: Optional exact resolved artifact prohibitions: sha256: plus 64 lowercase hex digits or sha512- plus canonical Base64 of 64 bytes. Does not fetch artifacts.

require_metadata.description: Explicit required boolean: true requires fresh complete exact-version metadata and verification configuration; false selects offline assessment while preserving source, context and review checks.

id.description: Unique registry label, 1-128 ASCII characters: first letter or underscore, followed by letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.

ecosystem.description: npm or pypi; selects metadata API and package-name matching behavior.

metadata_url.description: Canonical HTTPS API base, at most 512 characters at runtime. No credentials, query, fragment or encoded/noncanonical path. npm appends name; PyPI appends name/json.

install_url.description: Canonical HTTPS registry/index base permitted as an effective install source, at most 512 characters. Unique per ecosystem. Does not itself approve a command.

default.description: Optional, default false; at most one per ecosystem. Fallback for documentation metadata routing only. Assessment requires explicit supported source flags.

packages.description: Nonempty metadata-name disclosure list, 1-256 patterns of at most 256 characters. Exact names or star patterns; special * permits all including scoped npm names. Not an execution allowlist.

auth_env.description: Optional Bearer-token environment-variable name, not the secret. Format: first letter/underscore, then letters/digits/underscore, 1-128 characters. Unavailable credentials report unauthorized.

allow_private_network.description: Optional, default false. Allows private/loopback access only for this registry; reserved/link-local restrictions and TLS verification remain.

registries.description: Up to 16 registry configurations with unique IDs and ecosystem/install URL pairs. Empty authorizes no package metadata destination.

dns_hosts.description: Optional exact destination DNS disclosure list, at most 128 hosts. Default empty; no wildcard, URL or port. Lowercase/final-dot normalization; no content fetching or ownership proof.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-lookup timeout. Omitted or zero defaults to 5 seconds; effective range 1-30.

max_requests.description: Lookup-attempt budget shared across a verifier scan, including destination DNS checks. Omitted or zero defaults to 64; effective range 1-256.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Process-local package observation lifetime cap. Omitted or zero defaults to 300 seconds; effective range 1-3600. Negative evidence is additionally capped at 60 seconds.

min_interval_ms.description: Minimum interval between lookup attempts. Omitted or zero defaults to 100 milliseconds; effective range 1-10000. Zero does not disable throttling.

verification.description: Nested verification policy. Required when require_metadata is true; allowed registry install sources still need matching entries in offline mode. Package disclosure lists never approve execution.

description: Operator-controlled policy for exact action assessment. Policy does not execute actions or create isolation. See docs/policies.md for defaults, runtime constraints and review workflow.
